faqs.question: Is this a live restaurant website?
faqs.answer: No. This is a preview-safe demo generated from Restaurant Template v1.

faqs.question: Can this be deployed to production?
faqs.answer: Not in this workflow. Production routes and custom domains remain blocked until a separate guarded process is explicitly approved.

faqs.question: What makes this AFO-ready?
faqs.answer: The Worker includes smoke-testable routes, structured schema, llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and a clear preview-only receipt trail.
